justify_why_units_are_missing.justification: X-axes are labeled with cytometry parameters (e.g., FSC-A, Viability, CD19, IgD) that represent continuous measurements (light scatter or fluorescence intensity) but no measurement units are shown (e.g., channels, arbitrary units, or volts).
Y-axes are labeled with cytometry parameters (e.g., FSC-H, SSC-A, CD4, Fas, IgM) representing continuous signals but likewise lack explicit units on the axis labels or tick marks.
X-axes show cytometry parameters (e.g., CD19, IgD) that are continuous fluorescence/size measurements but no units are indicated on the axes.
Y-axes show cytometry parameters (e.g., CD98, FSC-A) that are continuous measurements but do not include units (no AU, channels, or other unit labels).

X-axes (e.g., IgD, NP, CD138, CD138/CD38 scales) display continuous cytometry intensity scales but lack explicit units (log-scale numeric ticks are present but no unit label such as AU or channel number).
Y-axes (e.g., IgM, Fas, CD38) are continuous cytometry measurements and do not show units on the axis labels or in the plot area.
X-axes (e.g., CD44, PD-L2) show numeric log-scale values typical of fluorescence intensity but provide no unit label (no AU, channels, or instrument-specific unit).
Y-axes (e.g., CD62L, CD80) are continuous fluorescence measurements; units are not indicated on the axes or elsewhere in the panel.
X-axes (CD44, PD-L2) are continuous cytometry intensity scales (with numeric ticks) but do not include explicit units such as arbitrary units (AU) or channel numbers.
Y-axes (CD62L, CD80) represent continuous fluorescence/marker intensity without any unit labeling on the axes or in the figure caption.
